verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's docs describe environments for managing flags from local development through production, with unlimited additional environments and a per-environment change log, which implies independent flag states. Nothing in the evidence documents per-environment SDK keys. API token scoping is a different credential type and is not credited here. missing for 10: documented per-environment SDK keys, explicit documentation that flag targeting/state is independent per environment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage separate environments (dev/staging/prod) with independent flag states and scoped SDK keys

citations.quote: Environments allow you to manage your feature flags throughout your entire development lifecycle, from local development through production.
You can create as many additional environments as you need.
LaunchDarkly keeps a running log of changes made to feature flags and other resources in each environment.
